text:
miranda: saw a 3x bump in prefill misses during compactor run this morning. quick postmortem?

samir: logs show pins vanished from meta blobs after compaction pass. sweeper then evicted.

olivia: we intentionally drop short-lived fields during compaction to save space. didn't think about ephemeral lease pins.

kevin: options: keep pins in meta (stop dropping), move pins to dedicated keyspace, or switch to generation tokens.

drew: short-term: flip compactor to preserve pin field until we have a plan. add alert for any dropped-pin bytes.

miranda: agree. medium-term: prototype small-key token namespace and a unix-ms token as generation (cheap). test multi-node renew races.

samir: note: token-as-unix-ms needs skew window. accept small false-positives or use server token later.

olivia: proto plan: write token on renew with expiry 15s; sweeper requires last_seen fresh OR token present and not expired.

ops-bot: compactor run completed at 2026-03-22T11:02:05Z (cluster=staging)

kevin: owners: miranda compactor flag flip + alert (today), olivia prototype token ns (1w), samir perf/chaos tests (1w), drew dashboards (today).

miranda: also add trace-id propagation through compactor so we can map which pass removed a field.

drew: adding dashboard tiles: evict_reason, dropped_pin_bytes, token_write_qps.

miranda: cool. run compactor flip in staging canary now and watch evict_rate/prefill_miss_rate. call if it spikes.

olivia: will open PR for token namespace sketch and piggyback options.

miranda: thanks all. short and sharp.
